headline_seed: Another vessel seized off Somali coast as threat level increased
description_seed: The UK's maritime monitor has reported at least four suspected piracy incidents in the past week off the coast of Somalia.

what: Another vessel seized off Somali coast as threat level increased

clean_source_blocks.text: Maritime authorities are warning of an increased threat to ships off the coast of Somalia after a cargo ship became the latest vessel to be seized in a suspected act of piracy.
The UK's maritime monitor has reported at least four suspected piracy incidents in the past week off the coast of Somalia.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) raised the threat level in the area to "substantial" as it reported "unauthorised persons" seized the vessel and re-directed it to Somalia's territorial waters on Sunday.
At least four vessels have been targeted in suspected piracy incidents in the last week including a fishing vessel and oil tanker.

source_text:
Maritime authorities are warning of an increased threat to ships off the coast of Somalia after a cargo ship became the latest vessel to be seized in a suspected act of piracy.

The UK's maritime monitor has reported at least four suspected piracy incidents in the past week off the coast of Somalia.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) raised the threat level in the area to "substantial" as it reported "unauthorised persons" seized the vessel and re-directed it to Somalia's territorial waters on Sunday.

At least four vessels have been targeted in suspected piracy incidents in the last week including a fishing vessel and oil tanker.
